???

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] rstan fail
parts:
On Friday, August 10, 2012 9:42:38 AM UTC-4, Jiqiang Guo wrote:
Ben: I did not import `print` from any other package.  Could you think of any reason that would prevent my print function being called? And in the case, what is the best way to tell which print function gets called?

For a long time, there was no S4 print function, and that might still be the case today. Instead, the S4 function that prints to the screen is show() and you can write methods for that. If someone does

posterior <- stan()
posterior

This will implicitly call the show() method, but would implicitly call the print() method if posterior were not a S4 object.

Ben
